entities.title: zazz-script-runner
entities.summary: The zazz-script-runner crate: the wasmtime host that the daemon starts to AOT-compile, test and run zazz scripts as WebAssembly.
entities.purpose: Holds the one binary of the workspace that embeds wasmtime, kept apart from daemon so the daemon carries no WebAssembly runtime and so the runtime's newer Rust requirement (rust-version 1.97, against 1.85 for the rest of the workspace) stays in one crate. The crate manifest (Cargo.toml, each dependency commented with its one reason: ureq, wasmtime, wasmtime-wasi, zazz-script-engine) and the source in src/.
boundaries: Never started by a person in normal use: the daemon runs `zazz-script-runner compile` and `zazz-script-runner test` for `zazz add` and `zazz test`, and keeps `zazz-script-runner serve` processes warm for `zazz call` (src/macos/daemon/src/zazz).
Knows nothing of the registry, signatures, trust or manifests: the daemon hands it a precompiled module on fd 4 and the effective preopens, network policy and limits in a hello frame.
The frame format, descriptor passing, the HTTP wire layout and the host allowlist check come from zazz-script-engine (src/macos/zazz-script/engine), shared with the scripts themselves.
Does not apply the OS sandbox itself; the daemon starts it inside one (pool.rs spawn runs it through sandbox::command with the policy call.rs builds).

relationships.description: The zazz module of daemon, which starts this binary.
